name: 5549-solodecode-dsv2litefp8-1gpu
parallelism: tp1. One GPU of an 8-GPU node; no tensor, pipeline, data or expert parallelism, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, 27 layers, MLA, 64 routed + 2 shared experts with top-6 routing, 15.7B total / 2.4B active, per-tensor FP8 (static, no weight_block_size), ~16 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop) with streams=1 -- one request in flight at a time. Warmup the first 25%, bounded at 32 requests, 900 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` over /v1/completions, single turn, no prefix structure. Exactly 256 prompt tokens (stdev 0) generating exactly 1024 output tokens (stdev 0), seed 42, `ignore_eos` and `temperature: 0` sent explicitly on the body.
purpose: A single-user coding assistant on one GPU, streaming long 1024-token completions from short prompts, one request at a time.
launch:
model-path: RedHatAI/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 1

attention-backend: fa3

# HAZARD, not a preference: the checkpoint advertises 163840 positions via YaRN, and
# ReqToTokenPool is an int32 device tensor of (max_num_reqs, context_len) -- at the advertised
# window that is ~1.3 TB and the server never starts. The longest request here is 1280 tokens.
context-length: 8192

chunked-prefill-size: 8192
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42

# Every prompt is distinct synthetic text, and a prefix hit would be the difference between a
# request having a prefill and not having one.
disable-radix-cache: true
